name: 12 Labours of Hercules XVIII: Ghost Sheep - Collector's Edition
storyline:
Hercules was enjoying a rare moment of peace in the lush gardens of Hellas. But when Megara asked for help watering the trees, his legendary strength led to unintended chaos. Cracking the earth, Hercules unleashed the waters of the underground river Styx - only to dry it up moments later. The floodwaters rushed across Hellas, awakening ancient curses, restless spirits, and causing chaos in the underworld.

Now, furious Hades demands answers, and Hercules must embark on a perilous journey to restore harmony. Across cursed landscapes, he must battle ghostly creatures, repair the land, and reclaim sacred waters before it's too late. Along the way, gods and mythical beings emerge to test his courage and wit.
summary: Help Hercules battle mischievous ghosts, restore balance to Hellas, and unravel ancient mysteries. Collector's Edition includes an interactive guide, wallpapers, bonus levels and even more sheep.
